title: FIND matches case: FIND ( "red", "Red red" ) is 5

source.quote: Returns the starting position of one text string within another text string. FIND is case-sensitive.

source.supports: the result is an integer position

derivation: "Red" at position 1 has a capital R and does not match; "red" starts at position 5 (R1 e2 d3 space4 r5). SEARCH would return 1.
